sections.Profile:
"Poker Plus" is a pinball machine produced by Recel S.A., available in both electro-mechanical (EM) and solid-state (SS) versions. The EM version was released in 1977, featuring two flippers, one pop bumper, two slingshots, five drop targets, and one standup target. The SS version followed in April 1978, maintaining similar playfield features.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s
